resources.string: Enable Wireless Debugging in Developer Options, then enter the pairing code below.
Pairing failed. Check the code and try again.

Ticked apps play on your Bluetooth speaker. Everything else stays on your phone: TalkBack, notifications, ringtone, alarms and all other apps. Apps no longer pause each other, so the speaker and your phone can play at the same time. Turning the hub on or off pauses what is playing once. To keep calls off the speaker, turn off Phone calls for the speaker in the Bluetooth settings.
No root access. The hub needs root (Magisk).
Off. Your phone works as usual.
On. Waiting for a Bluetooth speaker. Until one connects, everything plays on your phone.
On, but no app is ticked. Everything plays on your phone.
On. To %2$s: %1$s. Everything else stays on your phone.
Tick at least one app first.
Not started: Bluetooth hardware offload is still on. See First needed below.

Routing stopped: Bluetooth still shares your phone\'s main sound output, so your phone\'s own sounds would go to the speaker too. Restart your phone after turning on Disable Bluetooth A2DP hardware offload, then turn the hub on again.

Open Developer options and turn on Disable Bluetooth A2DP hardware offload, then restart your phone. Without it, Bluetooth shares your phone\'s main sound output and the hub cannot keep them apart. To undo: turn it off and restart.
Ticked apps play on the speaker. You can change this while the hub is on.
Ticked apps play on the Bluetooth speaker, everything else on your phone.

For playing on a Bluetooth speaker. TalkBack, notification sounds, ringtones and alarms stay on the phone speaker. Apps no longer pause each other, so music on the speaker and a video on your phone can play at the same time. Calls still interrupt. Turning it on pauses what is playing once.
On. TalkBack and notifications stay on the phone, and apps can play at the same time.
Off. Everything follows the Bluetooth speaker, and a new app pauses the one playing.
Send one app to another output

Example: Spotify plays on your Bluetooth speaker. Pick YouTube and Phone speaker, then tap Start: YouTube plays on your phone while Spotify keeps playing on the speaker. Tap Stop and YouTube follows the speaker again. Your Bluetooth speaker does not need to be in the output list for this: everything plays there by default.
ADB not connected. Please set up wireless debugging.
Permission denied. Please grant the required permissions.
